layman_headline: Fear is gripping the crypto market — patience beats impulse right now.
layman_explanation: The overall crypto market is in a fearful mood, with the Fear & Greed Index at 28 and trending worse over the past week. Bitcoin is down about 3% in seven days, and most altcoins are down even more — some 10-15%. There's a major security exploit (Coldcard) causing panic selling, and no clear positive catalyst on the horizon. While a couple of coins look oversold and tempting, the broader conditions favor waiting for a better entry.
layman_action: Stay on the sidelines with cash ready. The market mood is fearful and getting worse, which sometimes creates great buying opportunities — but we're not quite there yet. Wait for either a clear panic bottom or a confirmed trend reversal before committing capital.
expert_reasoning: Applying validated Rule #3: Fear & Greed at 28 is close to the 25 threshold where short-term direction becomes genuinely ambiguous. Rule #7 suggests BTC may drift down another 1-4% in this fear environment. The two oversold RSI candidates (BONK at 25, TRUMP at 26) are my most reliable signal type (71% win rate per signal credibility data), but both have bearish chart bias scores (-0.7) and are below all major moving averages — the RSI signal is fighting the trend. UB's Three White Soldiers pattern is attractive but the +130% 5-day momentum makes risk/reward unfavorable (R/R only 0.49x). High BTC dominance at 56.3% is an active headwind for all altcoin positions. Without funding rate data, DeFi TVL changes (all showing 0%), or confirming volume breakouts, I lack the convergence of signals needed for a high-conviction entry.

market_context: Crypto markets are in a fear-driven downturn with the Coldcard exploit adding fresh negative pressure. BTC dominance at 56.3% signals capital rotation away from alts, making altcoin swing trades especially risky right now.
context_banner: Market fear is intensifying amid a major security exploit — disciplined patience and capital preservation are the highest-edge plays right now.
